title: Right Understanding
speaker: Shuko Edie Norton
summary: The main teaching of Edie's Soto Zen dharma talk emphasizes the importance of embracing impermanence and letting go of resistance in order to cultivate true understanding of reality. This involves adopting a gentle approach to Zazen, where one sits in stillness without trying to achieve enlightenment through thinking or doing, allowing for a deeper understanding of interconnectedness and emptiness. By releasing preconceptions and habitual responses, one can experience the present moment more fully and embody the Buddha's teachings, leading to a profound sense of inner being and reality.
